name: awesome-llm-apps
description: 100+ AI Agents, Agent Skills and RAG Apps - Free and Open Source.
one_liner: A giant free catalog of ready-made AI mini-apps and 'skills' (like a fraud-investigation agent or a home-renovation redesigner) that anyone can clone and run.
buyer: A solo developer or small agency owner who wants to quickly demo or ship an AI feature (e.g. an insurance-claim assistant) to a client without building it from scratch.
business_use_cases: A freelance AI developer clones a relevant template (e.g. the AI Fraud Investigation Agent) as the starting point for a paid client project, cutting delivery time dramatically.
A content creator ('Unwind AI') builds a newsletter and course business teaching people how to use and customize these templates.
An agency packages the 'Project Graveyard' or 'Self-Improving Agent Skills' templates into a productized consulting offer for other developers' teams.

money_ideas.idea: Run a paid newsletter/course teaching non-experts how to deploy and customize these templates for real business problems.
Offer 'implementation as a service': take a specific template and customize/host it for a paying small-business client.

steal_this: Pick one high-demand template (like the insurance claim voice agent) and turn it into a polished, hosted micro-SaaS for a specific vertical this weekend.
